# logos nogo cross-package facts: a printf wrapper and a guarded type export
# facts from a main-module dependency; the importer is flagged via those
# facts. Deps alone are clean. Helper is $GOROOT/lib/logos-nogo.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Go facts: wrapper misuse and unguarded access both fail in the importer.
cd gomod
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.go:9:.*\[nogo::printf\]'
stderr 'main\.go:11:.*\[nogo::checklocks\]'
! stderr 'eject'
cd ..

# The fact exporters are clean on their own.
cd gomod
logos lint ./wrap ./guard
! stderr .
cd ..

# The importer builds: nogo runs only under logos lint.
cd gomod
logos build ./...
! stderr .
go build ./...
! stderr .
cd ..

# loGo/s facts: same wrapper and guard in .lgo map to the original .lgo.
cd lgomod
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.lgo:9:.*\[nogo::printf\]'
stderr 'main\.lgo:11:.*\[nogo::checklocks\]'
! stderr 'eject'
cd ..

cd lgomod
logos lint ./wrap ./guard
! stderr .
cd ..

cd lgomod
logos build ./...
! stderr .
cd ..

-- gomod/go.mod --
module example.com/factsgo

go 1.27

-- gomod/main.go --
package main

import (
	"example.com/factsgo/guard"
	"example.com/factsgo/wrap"
)

func main() {
	println(wrap.Wrapf("%d", "hello"))
	b := &guard.Shared
	b.Val = 1
	b.Mu.Lock()
	b.Val = 2
	b.Mu.Unlock()
}

-- gomod/wrap/wrap.go --
// Package wrap provides a printf wrapper.
package wrap

import "fmt"

func Wrapf(format string, args ...any) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)
}

-- gomod/guard/guard.go --
// Package guard provides a guarded box.
package guard

import "sync"

type Box struct {
	Mu sync.Mutex
	// +checklocks:Mu
	Val int
}

// Shared is an existing guarded object.
var Shared Box

-- lgomod/go.mod --
module example.com/factslgo

go 1.27

-- lgomod/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"example.com/factslgo/guard"
	"example.com/factslgo/wrap"
)

func main() {
	println(wrap.Wrapf("%d", "hello"))
	b := &guard.Shared
	b.Val = 1
	b.Mu.Lock()
	b.Val = 2
	b.Mu.Unlock()
}

-- lgomod/wrap/wrap.lgo --
// Package wrap provides a printf wrapper.
package wrap

import "fmt"

func Wrapf(format string, args ...any) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)
}

-- lgomod/guard/guard.lgo --
// Package guard provides a guarded box.
package guard

import "sync"

type Box struct {
	Mu sync.Mutex
	// +checklocks:Mu
	Val int
}

// Shared is an existing guarded object.
var Shared Box
